headline: BMW Steps Up Job Cuts and Warns of Profit Drop Amid China Woes
summary: BMW reported a drop in third-quarter profit and warned of a possible car division loss, announcing plans to accelerate job cuts due to cutthroat competition and falling demand in China.
why: Major automaker earnings and strategic warnings reflect broader economic pressures in China and intensifying pricing competition across the global electric and luxury vehicle markets.

impacts.name: BMW
impacts.why: Profit warnings and potential segment losses negatively impact equity value.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Intensifying competition and falling demand in China prompted profit warnings and accelerated restructuring measures.
